Resin Rock

A stone floor that drains and takes a design.

Rich is an approved Resin Rock installer. Resin Rock is stone set in a resin binder, and water passes straight through it. It goes down as a driveway, a patio, a pool deck or a walkway.

Shapes and logos can be set into the floor, and glow stones give a porch a night look of its own.

About Rich

Twenty years flying for the Army. Now he builds backyards.

Rich retired after 20 years in the U.S. Army as a pilot, and the business is veteran owned. He says that time shaped how he runs a job: discipline and accountability.

That helicopter is set into a Resin Rock floor, one of his own.
